name: addWatchlistProduct
description: Add a listing to the signed-in user's watchlist by productListingId so they can follow it and, with notifications on (the default), hear about changes. A listing already on the watchlist returns CONFLICT; subscription tier limits apply.

name: createUserAddress
description: Save a new private address with a label and its location in the signed-in user's address book; Aura Historia resolves the location for shipping estimates. Each call creates a new address, so repeating a call that timed out can create a duplicate.

name: createUserSearchFilter
description: Save a listing search for the signed-in user. Aura Historia matches new listings against it in the background and, with notifications on (the default), notifies the user, so matches appear later. Subscription tier limits apply. Each call creates a new saved search, so repeating a call that timed out can create a duplicate.

AcceptShippingDestinationData.description:
Optional acceptance guard. The submitted country must equal the authorized address or
preference's asserted country. Neither the reference nor provider evidence is retained.

name: deleteNotification
description: Permanently delete one of the signed-in user's notifications by notificationId. Returns an empty object; an unknown ID returns NOT_FOUND.

name: deleteNotifications
description: Permanently delete every notification of the signed-in user, including those beyond the listed page. Takes no arguments. Returns an empty object.

name: deleteUserAddress
description: Permanently delete one of the signed-in user's saved addresses. expectedVersion must equal its current version. If the address is the browsing destination, that destination is cleared too. Returns an empty object.

name: deleteUserSearchFilter
description: Permanently delete one of the signed-in user's saved searches. Returns an empty object; an unknown ID returns NOT_FOUND.

name: deleteWatchlistProduct
description: Remove a listing from the signed-in user's watchlist by productListingId. Returns an empty object; a listing that is not on the watchlist returns NOT_FOUND, also after an earlier call removed it.

name: discoverPartyLocations
description: Find the public locations, such as shops and showrooms, of the dealers and auction houses that Aura Historia indexes, within countries or subdivisions or within a radius around a point. Returns each location's business, label, country, coordinates and precision, and with distanceOrder its distance from the point. Returns 1 to 100 locations per page (default 21); pass the returned searchAfter object unchanged to get the next page.

size.description: Page size from 1 through 100, validated by the discovery use case.

name: getAuction
description: Get one auction by its auctionId: name, provider, format, schedule, reported status, reported and visible lot counts, and the link to its catalogue at the provider.

name: getAuctionCatalogue
description: List the lots of one auction by its auctionId in catalogue order, as listings in the requested language and currency with shipping details. Pass the returned searchAfter object as a JSON string to get the next page. For a signed-in user, each result also carries userState sections for which the token has the read scope: watchlist:read, search-filters:read, notifications:read or users:read.

name: getBrowsingDestination
description: Get the destination Aura Historia uses to estimate shipping while the signed-in user browses: NONE, one of their saved addresses (ADDRESS) or a country with an optional postal code (COUNTRY_POSTAL), with its version.

name: getProductListing
description: Get the full details of one listing by its productListingId: text, prices, images, provider, availability, auction and shipping, in the requested language and currency. Use it when the user wants more than a search result shows. For a signed-in user, each result also carries userState sections for which the token has the read scope: watchlist:read, search-filters:read, notifications:read or users:read.

inputSchema.description: Existing presentation query used by listing detail and similarity reads.
inputSchema.title: ListingInput

name: getProductListingByTitleSlug
description: Get the full details of one listing by its productListingTitleSlugId, the last segment of an Aura Historia listing page URL (/products/{slug}). Returns the same details as the lookup by productListingId. For a signed-in user, each result also carries userState sections for which the token has the read scope: watchlist:read, search-filters:read, notifications:read or users:read.

inputSchema.description: Existing presentation query used by listing detail and similarity reads.
inputSchema.title: SlugInput

name: getProductListingHistory
description: Get the complete history of one listing by its productListingId: when it was first seen and every recorded change, in event order. Use it for questions about price development or past changes. With currency, each price is also converted at the exchange rate of its event. Returns every event in one result; a history too large for one response fails instead of being truncated.

inputSchema.description: Existing optional REST history presentation query, reused by MCP arguments.
inputSchema.title: HistoryInput

name: getPublicListingSourceBySlug
description: Get the public profile of one provider (a dealer, auction house, marketplace or auction platform) by its listingSourceSlugId, the last segment of an Aura Historia provider page URL (/shops/{slug}): name, operator, website and image.

name: getPublicOverview
description: Get the latest calculated statistics of the Aura Historia catalogue: live listings, listings added in the last seven days, countries, languages and indexed providers by type, with the time they were calculated. Takes no arguments.

name: getSimilarProductListings
description: Find listings similar to one listing, identified by its productListingId. Returns up to a fixed number of neighbours in the requested language and currency. EMBEDDING_PENDING means the listing is not yet prepared for comparison and a later call can succeed; READY with an empty list means nothing similar was found. For a signed-in user, each result also carries userState sections for which the token has the read scope: watchlist:read, search-filters:read, notifications:read or users:read.

inputSchema.description: Existing presentation query used by listing detail and similarity reads.
inputSchema.title: ListingInput

name: getUserAccount
description: Get the signed-in user's Aura Historia account: email, name, language, currency and measurement unit, content preference, marketing consent, subscription tier and role.

name: getUserAddress
description: Get one of the signed-in user's saved addresses by addressId, with its resolved location and the attribution of the geocoding provider.

name: getUserSearchFilter
description: Get one of the signed-in user's saved searches by userSearchFilterId, with its criteria, state and notification settings.

name: getUserSearchFilters
description: List all of the signed-in user's saved searches with their criteria, state and notification settings. Takes no arguments.

name: getWatchlistProductListings
description: List the listings on the signed-in user's watchlist with their full details and notification settings, in the requested language and currency. Pass the returned searchAfter array as a JSON string to get the next page.

searchAfter.description: JSON encoded [RFC3339 watchlist creation timestamp, ProductListing ID].

name: listAuctions
description: List auctions of the auction houses and platforms that Aura Historia indexes, filtered by provider, format, reported status and schedule period and sorted by creation or schedule time. Use it to find upcoming, running or past auctions. A schedule period needs timeRole, from and to together, and sorting by schedule time needs timeRole. Pass the returned searchAfter object as a JSON string to get the next page.

name: listNotifications
description: List the signed-in user's notifications, such as watchlist changes and new saved-search matches, with each listing as it was when notified, in the requested language. Returns up to size notifications (default 21, 1 to 100); pass the returned searchAfter array as a JSON string to get the next page.

searchAfter.description: JSON string of the returned [created, notificationId] array.

size.description: Defaults to 21 and is clamped to 1 through 100, as on REST.

name: listSearchFilterMatches
description: List the listings that matched one of the signed-in user's saved searches, oldest match first, in the requested language and currency. Matching runs in the background, so an empty first page means there are no matches yet. Returns up to size matches (default 21, 1 to 100); pass the returned searchAfter array unchanged to get the next page.

name: listUserAddresses
description: List the signed-in user's saved addresses with their resolved locations. Returns up to limit addresses (default 25, 1 to 100); pass the returned next as after to get the next page.

name: patchWatchlistProduct
description: Turn notifications for a watched listing on or off, or pause (INACTIVE_BY_USER) or resume (ACTIVE) the entry. Omitted fields stay unchanged and null is invalid; resuming is subject to subscription tier limits. Returns the listing with its full details in the requested language and currency.

inputSchema.description: Existing presentation query used by listing detail and similarity reads.
inputSchema.title: UpdateInput

name: searchPublicListingSources
description: Search the providers whose listings Aura Historia indexes (dealers, auction houses, marketplaces and auction platforms) by name. Without a query it browses all providers; a query too short to match returns no results. Returns 1 to 50 providers per page (default 21); pass the returned searchAfter unchanged, with the same query and size, to get the next page.

query.description: Optional source-name text; omission or whitespace browses, insufficient text returns no matches.

size.description: Page size from 1 through 50. Continuations are bound to the query and page size.

name: setBrowsingDestination
description: Set or clear the destination used to estimate shipping while the signed-in user browses: NONE clears it, ADDRESS selects one of their saved addresses and COUNTRY_POSTAL a country with an optional postal code. expectedVersion must equal the current version. Returns the new destination and version.

name: simpleSearchProductListings
description: Search Aura Historia's index of art, antiques and design objects listed by dealers, auction houses, marketplaces and auction platforms. Use it to find listings by text and by filters such as price, dates, availability, provider, auction, location and shipping. Returns listing summaries in the requested language and currency, with the total when known; pass the returned searchAfter object unchanged to get the next page. For a signed-in user, each result also carries userState sections for which the token has the read scope: watchlist:read, search-filters:read, notifications:read or users:read.

inputSchema.description: Query options shared by REST extraction and MCP's combined argument envelope.

size.description: Values are clamped to the existing service-supported range 1..=100.

inputSchema.title: SearchInput

name: updateAllNotificationsSeen
description: Mark every notification of the signed-in user as seen or unseen, including those beyond the listed page. Returns an empty object.

name: updateNotificationSeen
description: Mark one of the signed-in user's notifications as seen or unseen by notificationId. Returns an empty object; an unknown ID returns NOT_FOUND.

name: updateNotificationsSeen
description: Mark the signed-in user's notifications with the given notificationIds (at least one) as seen or unseen. Unknown IDs are ignored. Returns an empty object.

name: updateSearchFilterMatchFeedback
description: Record whether a listing that matched one of the signed-in user's saved searches is relevant: true or false sets the feedback, null clears it and omission keeps it. Returns the match; a listing that is not a current match returns NOT_FOUND.

name: updateUserAccount
description: Update the signed-in user's name, language, currency, measurement unit or whether unassessed or sensitive content is shown. Omitted fields stay unchanged and null clears an optional field; the content preference cannot be null. Returns the updated account.

name: updateUserAddress
description: Replace the label and location of one of the signed-in user's saved addresses. expectedVersion must equal the address's current version; a stale version returns CONFLICT. Returns the updated address.

name: updateUserSearchFilter
description: Change the name, criteria, state or notification setting of one of the signed-in user's saved searches. Omitted fields stay unchanged and null clears fields that can be cleared; availability, orderability and includeUnspecifiedAvailability change together. Matching against new criteria runs in the background. Returns the saved search.

AcceptShippingDestinationData.description:
Optional acceptance guard. The submitted country must equal the authorized address or
preference's asserted country. Neither the reference nor provider evidence is retained.
